verdict.rationale: Requesty is an LLM gateway, and a gateway could plausibly offer user-defined event-to-action automation, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no general rules engine where users define triggers and actions. Fallback policies (automatic retry on failure), spend caps and guardrails are fixed, routing- or governance-specific behaviors, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
